title: Verwijzing naar de data van: NSCR School project - pilot study
descriptions: Pilot for the NSCR School project among 148 vmbo (preporatory vociational) students in The Hague, partly pencil and paper, partly via computer. PILOT to test the questionnaire of the NSCR Schoolproject. The NSCR Schoolproject aimed to enhance insights into the complicated relations between delinquency and other problem behaviors, psycho-social development, peer networks, and school informal interventions.
Data available in consultation with NSCR. Please contact the datamanager [datamanagement@nscr.nl]

data_sources: Primarily preporatory vocational (vmbo) secondary school students from the province South Holland (N=148). The datacollection for this pilot took place at 2 schools in The Hague. It was conducted partly by paper and pencil and partly on the computer. Comparison did not result in large differences, students seemed to like the computer better.
